title: Exchange Online baseline external evidence
description: EVD-008. The closed document contract for versioned, signed external evidence before cryptographic, binding, freshness, uniqueness, replay, or payload-integrity decisions are made.

SchemaVersion.description: The version of this external-evidence document contract.

EvidenceId.description: The immutable RFC 4122 identifier used by ingestion to detect duplicates and replay.

TenantId.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant directory identifier the evidence was collected from.

DeploymentProfile.description: The shipped deployment profile the evidence is bound to.

ConfigurationHash.description: The lowercase SHA-256 digest of the resolved configuration, optionally carrying its algorithm prefix.

ControlId.description: The catalog control this document supplies external evidence for.

Collector.description: The versioned external implementation that generated the payload.

GeneratedAtUtc.description: The UTC instant at which the external collector completed this evidence.

PayloadHash.description: The lowercase SHA-256 digest of the canonical payload bytes, optionally carrying its algorithm prefix.

Payload.description: The structured external observation whose canonical bytes are bound by PayloadHash and Signature.

Signature.description: Metadata and value for the detached CMS signature. Cryptographic validity and signer authority are decided separately.
